Maruzensky delivered a run that captivated 
even Symboli Rudolf and claimed victory. 
She then set her sights on her next goal: 
the Yasuda Kinen.

Symboli Rudolf vowed to have a rematch 
with Maruzensky, declaring that she would 
definitely catch up to her back.

However, Maruzensky's running, which had 
captivated so many, was—

She had left a very different, massive 
impression on Special Week and Grass 
Wonder. An impression of an overwhelming 
wall...
